description: FY2025 full-year earnings deck for a premium home and lifestyle retailer expanding its omnichannel model.
provenance: Modeled on annual earnings decks from specialty retailers: comparable sales, channel and category mix, store productivity, inventory turns, capital returns, and next-year guidance. Deliberately exercises a seven-slide deck with a clustered bar chart, KPI cards carrying mixed trend directions, and detailed merchandising commentary.

content.title: Growth accelerated as digital and store experiences converged

content.title: Merchandising and customer signals
content.subtitle: Category performance and loyalty behavior
bulletPoints: Furniture comparable sales rose 7%, led by modular seating and made-to-order dining; average order value increased 5%
Kitchen and entertaining grew 4% as private-label cookware gained 180 bps of category share
Textiles declined 2% after planned SKU rationalization; gross margin improved 310 bps on lower clearance activity
Design-services revenue grew 19% and influenced $486M of merchandise sales, up from $361M in FY2024
Loyalty members represented 71% of sales and shopped 3.4 times annually versus 2.8 times one year ago
Mobile conversion reached 3.8%, up 60 bps, following checkout simplification and real-time store inventory

content.title: Stores and digital now reinforce one another.
content.subtitle: Maya Chen, President and Chief Executive Officer
prose: Digital demand lifts store productivity while pickup expands convenience.
Selective remodels and disciplined inventory protect returns.

content.title: FY2026 guidance and capital allocation
content.subtitle: Outlook as of March 19, 2026; fiscal year ending January 30, 2027
bulletPoints: Net sales growth of 5%-7%, including approximately 150 bps from net new square footage
Comparable sales growth of 3%-5%, with positive contributions expected from both stores and digital
Adjusted EBIT margin of 12.8%-13.2%, including $18M of incremental wage and benefits investment
Adjusted diluted EPS of $6.80-$7.15 versus $6.21 in FY2025
Capital expenditure of $210M-$225M; depreciation and amortization of approximately $118M
Plan to repurchase $250M-$300M of shares while maintaining net leverage below 1.0x EBITDA
